            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Good' THEN 3

            WHEN "conserve_status" = 'Poor' THEN 7

),
with_cpi AS (
    SELECT *,
        ROUND((("HIST_sign" + COALESCE("cultural_score", 0) + COALESCE("research_score", 0)) * (10 - "conserv_value")) / 30.0, 2) as "CPI"
